title: 第3章 画符第4章 五雷符
content_zh:
晨曦穿破云层，照耀在义庄的屋顶上.。
伴随着鸡鸣犬吠声，林道然睁开了眼，呆滞了几秒后，掀开被子然后翻身下床。林道然昨晚在房间里修炼，一直修炼到了黎明时分。
虽然一晚上只睡了一个时辰，但是此时的他并没有感到不适或者疲累，他只觉得浑身上下有一种前所未有的舒适感！
“舒坦，这修为快速增加的感觉也太令人着迷了，不知不觉修炼了一晚上，看这情况，再按照这样修炼下去，估计两三天后就能突破人师七重了！“
精神奕奕的林道然伸了个懒腰，检查了下自己的修为后美滋滋地想着。
洗漱，然后给祖师上完香之后，林道然来到院子里，舒展了下筋骨，然后不急不慢跟着文才和九叔演练起了茅山炼体术。
林道然身穿练功服，扎稳马步，双手握拳，深吸一口气，身体随着茅山炼体术的招式变动中。挥拳发力时，身上的肌肉绷紧，线条分明，充满了力量的美感；收招时，肌肉舒张开来，一动一静之间都伴随着沉重的呼吸声，身体彷佛在跟一股看不见的力量抗衡着！
随着修炼的深入，林道然的身体慢慢开始颤抖起来，汗水浸湿了他的练功服并流淌到地上，在地上汇聚成了一滩小水洼。但林道然依旧咬紧牙关坚持着！突然，林道然大喝一声，用力打出一拳，全身的力量瞬间爆发，皮肤表面开始闪烁起古铜色的光泽，身体内也发出一连串“噼里啪啦”的声响，那是皮肤、血肉和骨骼进行强化的声音。
片刻后，修炼结束的林道然瘫坐在地上，大口大口地喘着粗气，脸上露出一股疲惫但满足的笑容。
“这十倍速度修炼的炼体术也太可怕了吧！差点把自己练死！以前能练习好几次的炼体术，现在练一次就力竭了，恐怖如斯！不过这次收获也很大阿！成功从铁体突破到了铜体了！“
文才跑过来扶起了林道然，口中着急地喊道。
“哇！师兄你这是怎么了？炼体也能练到走火入魔了吗？“
走在文才身后的九叔闻言给了文才脑袋一个暴扣，力度刚刚好，懵逼不伤脑。
“说什么胡话？快点去把早饭准备好，你师兄这是突破了。“
九叔看着林道然皮肤上闪烁的古铜色光泽，眉梢一喜，伸出手指使劲的捏了捏林道然的皮肤，指尖传来的坚实触感使九叔确认了林道然的炼体境界已经突破到了铜体了！九叔的眼里闪过一丝欣慰和自豪，笑着开口道。
“铜体境了？看来等你四目师叔送完客户回来后，可以让你跟着他去历练历练了！”
“嗯！铜体了。”
林道然挠了挠头，憨憨地笑着。
“好，去冲洗一下，然后来吃饭了。”
九叔拍打了一下林道然的肩膀，然后笑着转身走向了大厅。

吃完早饭之后，秋生也到了。九叔让三人去沐浴焚香，然后来供奉着祖师的房间，准备检验下三人的符箓水平，至于四目道长？他还没睡醒，在补觉呢！
三人按照九叔的要求，沐浴焚香之后，来到了房间里集合。
每个人面前都放着一张小桌子，桌子上面放着根毛笔、一碗混合朱砂等材料制成的墨水和一沓黄纸。
九叔站在三人面前严肃地说道：“师父我是茅山符箓一脉的，专精于符箓一道，所以你们作为我的弟子，自然也是要学会符箓这一道！“
“今天每个人只要给我画出三张黄符即为合格。要是画不出三张黄符的，哼哼……“
九叔虽然没有明说失败的惩罚，但是看着他那不善的眼神！秋生和文才同时打了个寒颤！
“怎么办？我运气好的时候才能画出一张符，一天内画出三张，做不到啊！“
文才苦着脸拉了拉秋生的袖子。
“没事，先画着，晚点等师父不在身边的时候，我们找大师兄帮忙，让他帮我们画几张凑凑数！“
秋生眼睛一转，像是心有成竹了一般，对着文才小声道。
就在秋生帮着文才出主意的时候，林道然已经拿起毛笔，随着口中的咒语念动，手腕轻转，沾着朱砂墨的笔尖落在了黄纸上，一笔一划的刻画起了符文，慢慢的，那张黄纸上开始布满了符文，随着林道然的最后一笔落下，那张满是符文的黄纸也亮起了一股黄光，一张镇尸符悄然完成。
一张、两张、三张……
林道然的心神在不知不觉间已经完全沉入了画符之中，十倍修炼增幅使他对镇尸符的理解不断地加深着，镇尸符的符文如同一个个小蝌蚪一样，不停地围绕在他的身边，主动赤裸地解析给林道然。林道然之前感觉晦涩难懂的符文构造和书写时的法力注入量等问题，正在被他慢慢地破解着，而他对镇尸符的理解也在逐步的加深。
在书写第五张镇尸符时，林道然的脑海突然一阵清明，手上的书写速度也在慢慢地降下来，脸色开始逐渐苍白，额头上冒出了细密的汗珠，背后的衣裳被汗水浸湿，每一笔符文的绘画都变得艰难无比，仿佛是在与无形的阻力做着斗争。最后一笔落下，黄纸上泛起了一丝微弱的银白色亮光，林道然成功画出了银符境界的镇尸符。
时刻注意着林道然的九叔，看到这股银白色亮光后，立马走了过来，震惊地拿起了镇尸符，仔细检查了一番。
在他的感应下，这确实是一张银符，虽然只是一张刚入银符境界的镇尸符，但那也是银符啊，只要能画出一张银符境界的符箓，那么其他符箓也将很快到达银符境界。
“好！好！好啊！道然你的镇尸符已经达到了银符境界了！画符进步堪称神速，才学了两年就达到了银符境界，看来以后有望金符境甚至是紫符境了！“
九叔兴奋的笑着。
“嘿嘿，这都是仰仗于师父的教导！“
林道然看着九叔的笑容，苍白没有血色的脸上也露出了一抹笑容。

“师父，我想下午开始学习中级符箓，可以吗？“
“嗯，当然可以！你拿着这本书吧，自己先看看，要是有不懂的再来问师父。“九叔微笑着递给林道然一本茅山符箓大全之后，连秋生和文才的画符任务都不检查了，直接把三人打发出去。
等林道然带着两个懵逼的师弟走后，九叔关上了房门，然后拿着闪着银白色光芒的镇尸符，如同中了彩票一般跑到祖师爷的香炉前。
先恭敬地上了柱香，然后向祖师爷炫耀着，我徒道然有着天师之资，修行、炼体、符箓等天赋都是百年难得一见之类的话！
九叔向祖师爷炫耀完自己的弟子后，就回到了院子里的摇椅上躺着了，毕竟祖师爷的神像都已经背过身去了，再说下去晚上怕是会被祖师爷检查修为哦！
content_en:
The morning sun breaks through the clouds and shines on the roof of Yizhuang.
Accompanied by the crowing of cocks and the barking of dogs, Lin Daoran opened his eyes. After being stunned for a few seconds, he lifted the quilt and rolled out of bed. Lin Daoran practiced in his room last night until dawn.
Although he only slept for an hour one night, he did not feel uncomfortable or tired at this time. He only felt an unprecedented sense of comfort all over his body!
"Shu Tan, the feeling of this rapid increase in cultivation is so fascinating. I have been practicing for a whole night without realizing it. Judging from this situation, if I continue to practice like this, I estimate that I will be able to break through to the seventh level of human master in two or three days!"
Lin Daoran, who was full of energy, stretched himself, checked his own cultivation and thought happily.
After washing and offering incense to his ancestor, Lin Daoran came to the yard, stretched his muscles and bones, and then followed Wencai and Uncle Jiu to practice the Maoshan Body Refining Technique in a leisurely manner.
Lin Daoran was wearing training clothes, steadying his horse stance, making fists with both hands, taking a deep breath, and his body was changing with the moves of Maoshan's physical training. When the punch is exerted, the muscles on the body are tightened and the lines are clear, full of the beauty of strength; when the move is withdrawn, the muscles are relaxed, and every movement and stillness are accompanied by heavy breathing, as if the body is contending with an invisible force!
As his practice deepened, Lin Daoran's body slowly began to tremble. Sweat soaked his training clothes and flowed to the ground, forming a small puddle on the ground. But Lin Daoran still gritted his teeth and persisted! Suddenly, Lin Daoran shouted loudly and punched hard. The power of his whole body exploded instantly. The surface of his skin began to shine with a bronze luster, and a series of "crackling" sounds came from his body. It was the sound of skin, flesh, and bones being strengthened.
After a while, Lin Daoran, who had finished practicing, collapsed on the ground, breathing heavily, with a tired but satisfied smile on his face.
"This body refining technique practiced at ten times the speed is too scary! I almost killed myself! I could practice the body refining technique several times before, but now I am exhausted after practicing it once. It is so scary! But this time the harvest is also great! I successfully broke through from the iron body to the copper body!"
Wencai ran over and helped Lin Daoran up, shouting anxiously.
"Wow! Senior brother, what's wrong with you? Can you practice physical training to the point of going crazy?"
Uncle Jiu, who was walking behind Wencai, heard this and gave Wencai a dunk on the head. The force was just right and it was not nerve-wracking.
"What nonsense are you talking about? Hurry up and prepare breakfast. Your senior brother has made a breakthrough."
Uncle Jiu looked at the shimmering bronze luster on Lin Daoran's skin, and his brows were happy. He stretched out his fingers and pinched Lin Daoran's skin hard. The solid touch from his fingertips confirmed that Lin Daoran's body refining realm had broken through to the bronze body! Uncle Jiu's eyes flashed with relief and pride, and he said with a smile.
"Are you in the Bronze Body Realm? It seems that after your Uncle Four Eyes comes back from seeing off his clients, you can practice with him!"
"Yeah! I have a bronze body."
Lin Daoran scratched his head and smiled naively.
"Okay, let's go take a shower and then come eat."
Uncle Jiu patted Lin Daoran on the shoulder, then turned and walked towards the hall with a smile.
After breakfast, Qiu Sheng also arrived. Uncle Jiu asked the three of them to bathe and burn incense, and then come to the room where the ancestor was enshrined, ready to test the three people's talisman skills. As for Taoist Priest Four Eyes? He hasn't woken up yet and is catching up on his sleep!
Following Uncle Jiu's request, the three of them came to the room to gather after bathing and burning incense.
There is a small table in front of everyone. On the table are a writing brush, a bowl of ink mixed with cinnabar and other materials, and a stack of yellow paper.
Uncle Jiu stood in front of the three people and said seriously: "Master, I am from the Maoshan Talisman lineage and specialize in the Talisman art. So as my disciples, you naturally have to learn the Talisman art!"
"Today everyone just needs to draw three pictures for me.Zhang Huang Fu is qualified. If you can't draw three yellow symbols, hum..."
Although Uncle Jiu did not explicitly mention the punishment for failure, he looked at him with that unkind look! Qiu Sheng and Wen Cai shuddered at the same time!
"What to do? I can only draw one talisman when I'm lucky, but I can't draw three in one day! "
Wencai pulled Qiusheng's sleeve with a grimace.
"It's okay, let's just draw it first. Later, when Master is no longer around, we can ask our senior brother for help and ask him to draw a few pictures for us to make up the numbers! "
Qiu Sheng rolled his eyes, as if he had a plan, and whispered to Wen Cai.
Just when Qiu Sheng was helping Wen Cai come up with ideas, Lin Daoran had already picked up the writing brush. As he chanted the incantation in his mouth, he turned his wrist lightly, and the tip of the pen stained with cinnabar ink fell on the yellow paper. He carved the runes one stroke at a time. Slowly, the yellow paper began to be covered with runes. As Lin Daoran's last stroke came down, the yellow paper full of runes also lit up with a yellow light, and a corpse suppressing talisman was quietly completed.
One, two, three...
Lin Daoran's mind was completely immersed in the painting of the talisman without knowing it. The tenfold increase in practice allowed him to continuously deepen his understanding of the corpse-suppressing talisman. The runes of the corpse-suppressing talisman were like little tadpoles, constantly surrounding him and actively analyzing them to Lin Daoran naked. Issues such as the structure of the runes and the amount of mana injected when writing, which Lin Daoran had previously thought were obscure, were slowly being solved by him, and his understanding of the corpse-suppressing talisman was gradually deepening.
While writing the fifth corpse-suppressing talisman, Lin Daoran's mind suddenly became clear, and the writing speed of his hand slowly slowed down. His face began to pale, and beads of sweat appeared on his forehead. The clothes on his back were soaked with sweat, and the painting of each rune became extremely difficult, as if he was fighting against invisible resistance. As the last stroke came down, a faint silver-white light appeared on the yellow paper, and Lin Daoran successfully drew the corpse-suppressing talisman of the silver talisman realm.
Uncle Jiu, who was always paying attention to Lin Daoran, immediately walked over after seeing this silvery white light. He picked up the corpse suppressing charm in shock and inspected it carefully.
Under his induction, this is indeed a silver talisman. Although it is just a corpse-suppressing talisman that has just entered the silver talisman realm, it is also a silver talisman. As long as one talisman of the silver talisman realm can be drawn, other talismans will soon reach the silver talisman realm.
"Okay! good! OK! Daoran, your corpse-suppressing talisman has reached the silver talisman realm! My progress in drawing talismans is very rapid. I have reached the silver talisman realm after only two years of learning. It seems that I can reach the gold talisman realm or even the purple talisman realm in the future! "
Uncle Jiu smiled excitedly.
"Hey, this is all based on Master's teachings! "
Lin Daoran looked at Uncle Jiu's smile, and a smile appeared on his pale and bloodless face.
"Master, I want to start learning intermediate talismans in the afternoon, is that okay? "
"Well, of course! Just take this book and read it yourself first. If you don’t understand anything, ask the Master. "Uncle Jiu smiled and handed Lin Daoran a Maoshan Talisman Encyclopedia. He didn't even check the talisman drawing tasks of Qiu Sheng and Wencai, and sent the three of them directly.
After Lin Daoran left with his two confused junior brothers, Uncle Jiu closed the door, then took the silver-white corpse suppressing charm and ran to the ancestor's incense burner as if he had won the lottery.
I first laid the incense stick respectfully, and then showed off to the Patriarch that I, Tu Daoruan, have the qualifications of a heavenly master. My talents in cultivation, body refining, and talismans are rare to see in a hundred years!
After Uncle Jiu showed off his disciples to the Patriarch, he returned to the yard and lay down on the rocking chair. After all, the statue of the Patriarch had turned away, and if he continued to talk about it at night, he would probably have his cultivation checked by the Patriarch!
